memory_candidates: NfComposition.lean lines 23-36 contains a formal counterexample proving that 1-var NF compositionality is FALSE for n>=2 on linear orders (even Prior structures): M=(Z,<), env1=(0,2), env2=(0,1), k=1 — between-zone nonemptiness differs despite same 1-var types and ordering

ExistPart as defined in KampMutualInduction.lean is architecturally limited: parent_atoms : AtomKind sig 1 -> Bool forces constant parent env (fun _ => t). Until/Since zones need non-constant parent env [x,t]. This is the root cause of the remaining sorries in KampBypass.lean.

nf_extend_fwd/nf_extend_bwd always lose one depth level: from depth-(K+1) arity-r agreement, they produce depth-K arity-(r+1) agreement. This makes recursive composition fail at the target depth for the KampBypass sorries.

Three approaches to fix: (A) Generalize ExistPart to Fin m parent env (~400-600 lines). (B) Port k=0 VecEA2 bracket formulas to depth k'+1 using ih_char (~800-1200 lines). (C) Reformulate mutual induction to avoid the backward direction (~300-500 lines, redesign).
EFGames/Composition.lean has GHR93 strategy composition but uses ExtendedCarrier/StaviFormula framework, incompatible with the NormalForm/nf_eval_nf framework in KampBypass.
